lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Do your teachings address what happens when the world ends?

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: We focus on what happens the moment before.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: You understand the veil better than most.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: I understand how to ask better questions about it.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: The ritual the monks recorded — does your order still practice it?

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: Some things are not practiced. They are endured.

lines.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines.text: Are you afraid of what we might find at the rift?

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: I have been trained to face what cannot be run from.
